text:
Maya R: quick sync — need to reshuffle tmrw's release train slots. two changes: ingest batching (small) and router config (medium). do we want them in same slot?
Alex L: prefer separate. smaller blast radius. i can take ingest at 10:00.
Tanvi P: i can do router at 11:30, or earlier if someone takes it sooner.
Rob C: i can slot routing at 10:30 if that helps. which endpoints touched?
Maya R: ingest-service + router-service. router touches traffic-splitting and header rewrite.
Samira K: heads-up — we'll need a DB snapshot + KV warmup before ingest deploy. i can run snapshot at 09:45. @Alex L pls confirm.
Alex L: confirmed. i'll do KV warmup 09:55 and quick canary 10:05. smoke window 10:05–10:15.
deploy-bot: slot reserved: @Alex L 3532101111 10:00-10:30 (deploy-queue ID d-8791)
Maya R: perfect. @Rob C if you take 10:30 routing, please own rollback plan.
Rob C: got it. rollback is standard:
```
# rollback steps
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service router-service --to-sha <previous_sha>
# verify routes and metrics
```
Tanvi P: noted — i'll stand by for 11:30 slot. if 10:30 works better for everyone, i'm flexible.
Alex L: smoke checklist I'll run: KV warmup, prefix cache hit >90%, latency p50/p95 check, error-rate <0.1%. link: https://go/release-smoke-checklist
Samira K: i'll post snapshot link when done and confirm retention.
Maya R: who is on pager 10-11? I'll be primary. @Tanvi P backup 10-12?
Tanvi P: yep backup.
Alex L: starting preflight in 20m (will ping here).
Samira K: snapshot complete: https://storage/release-snapshots/3532101111/snap-2026-03-17 :thumbsup:
Alex L: preflight pass, KV warmed, canary traffic running. pinging at 10:03 before full flip.
Maya R: thanks. please post smoke results here. if anything >threshold, rollback immediately and notify #eng-oncall.
Alex L: smoke ✅ all checks green p95 120ms, error rate 0.02%. promoting to full. :tada:
Rob C: monitoring router metrics during rollout. will alert if any anomalies.
Maya R: awesome — thanks team. filing deploy notes into the train doc after lunch.
